title: Gemini Deep Think reaches gold-medal level at the 2025 IMO
summary: An advanced version of Gemini Deep Think solved 5 of 6 problems at the 2025 IMO, scoring 35 out of 42 and working in natural language within the 4.5-hour limit. IMO coordinators assessed and certified the score, while clarifying that they do not validate the system.

evidence.tested: An advanced Gemini Deep Think version solved the official 2025 IMO problems within the time limit, and IMO coordinators graded and certified the 35 of 42 score with the same criteria as for students.
evidence.unknown: The IMO did not validate the system or model, and this version is not yet public and was first given to trusted testers.
evidence.ai_role: Gemini Deep Think worked end-to-end in natural language, exploring multiple solution paths in parallel.
